title: Worker Cancel/Retry CLI Controls
description: Add first-class commands to cancel stuck jobs and retry failed/canceled jobs without manual state edits.

riskProbes.title: Manual JSON state edits for recovery
riskProbes.advice: Add supported CLI operations for cancel/retry to avoid corrupting queue state.

steps.title: Define safe cancel/retry transitions
steps.description: Formalize which statuses can transition to canceled or pending retry.

steps.title: Implement worker-cancel and worker-retry
steps.description: Add CLI commands and state mutation helpers for deterministic cancel/retry operations.

steps.title: Add transition tests
steps.description: Validate command behavior for pending/running/failed/canceled/completed states.

steps.title: Document recovery commands
steps.description: Document operational runbooks for cancel/retry in both READMEs.

gates.title: No unresolved high/critical risks
gates.note: Do not ship if cancel/retry can produce invalid job lifecycle transitions.

rollbackHints: Keep worker state schema backward compatible.
Preserve existing worker-status and worker-run behavior.
edgeCases: Retry requested for completed job should be blocked by policy.
Cancel requested for stale running job should record explicit operator reason.
